I am deeply passionate about leveraging the power of data and machine learning to solve real-world problems. My academic focus is on developing intelligent systems that can learn from data, make predictions, and automate complex tasks. I am a proactive learner with hands-on experience in building machine learning models, working with various datasets, and exploring the latest trends in AI.
